text:
Denver Barkey was a third-round pick, 95th overall, a 5-foot-10 forward the Flyers took a flyer on in 2023. The Philadelphia Inquirer now calls that bet "starting to look like a masterstroke," and Rick Tocchet keeps playing him at center, where Broad Street Hockey says the coach "sees untapped potential."

The production backs it. Barkey has 13 points in 23 games, eight in his last ten, and we'd have expected about five over that stretch at his ice time. His own chances are up too. The finishing is the part to watch. He is scoring on almost 22% of his shots against a typical 14%, and our range puts his true rate between 11 and 17.

What should last is the defense. Evolving-Hockey had opponents getting 0.13 fewer expected goals per 60 with him on the ice last season (91st percentile), and his relative 5v5 expected-goals share this year is nearly 11 points better than the team's without him. PHLY Sports' Charlie O'Connor put it well: if a player tagged with star upside were posting these results in his first full season, "there'd be a ton of excitement around him." Barkey is earning some anyway.
headline: Denver Barkey keeps outgrowing his draft slot
